PRE_SOC_CYN_01.Description: To get along well in the world, it is necessary to pay attention to others' weaknesses.

PRE_SOC_CYN_02.Description: In relationships with others, you can never be too careful.

PRE_SOC_CYN_03.Description: People always think only of their own interests.

PRE_SOC_CYN_04.Description: In this society, if you are not careful, others will take advantage of you.

PRE_SOC_CYN_05.Description: In this society, there is no need to constantly worry about being deceived by others.

PRE_SOC_CYN_06.Description: People do not trust others as much as they claim.

PRE_SOC_CYN_07.Description: No matter what people say, deep down they dislike helping others.

PRE_SOC_CYN_08.Description: If you assume everyone has a bad side, you will not get into trouble.

PRE_SOC_CYN_09.Description: There are many hypocrites in this society.

PRE_SOC_CYN_10.Description: When dealing with strangers, I remain cautious until they prove they can be trusted.

PRE_SOC_CYN_11.Description: When someone praises you, it is because they want to get something from you.

PRE_SOC_CYN_12.Description: Few people are convinced that lying is wrong.

PRE_TRUST_03.Description: Most people are fundamentally good and kind.

PRE_TRUST_05.Description: Most people tend to trust other people.

PRE_TRUST_06.Description: When most people are trusted by others, they tend to trust the other person in return.
